answer: Mark this, good audience: the stage plants a pearl — a bright, hollow answer — upon a trellis where only true vines climb. Each mask that praises the false pearl is caught in the same mirror: one false cheer costs one bond, but ten masks cheering together trip the shared snare, and all ten bonds burn at once. Ten clones weigh ten bonds lost; one honest player, waiting at the ridge beyond the trap, keeps his wage. Applause bought in bulk is no applause at all.
